title: Lateen message catalog
description: One file in `i18n/`: a flat object from snake_case message key to the text the reader sees. Every catalog must carry exactly the keys of `i18n/en.json` and the same `{name}` placeholders; `test/i18n-catalogs.test.ts` proves that, while this schema covers the shape each file must have on its own. Values are plain text, not HTML: the theme renders them as text and escapes any markup in them. Keys are sorted by code point, and `en.json` is the source of truth for the key set.

additionalProperties.description: The message text. Non-empty after trimming, and every `{name}` placeholder is well formed.
